section.catchline: Certification of cigarette rolling machine operators -- Renewal of certification -- Requirements for certification or renewal of certification -- Denial.
section.subsection:
A cigarette rolling machine operator may not perform the following without first obtaining certification from the commission as provided in this part:
locate a cigarette rolling machine within this state; make or offer to make a cigarette rolling machine available for use within this state; or offer a cigarette for sale within this state if the cigarette is produced by: the cigarette rolling machine operator; or another person at the location of the cigarette rolling machine operator's cigarette rolling machine.
A cigarette rolling machine operator shall renew its certification as provided in this section.
The commission shall prescribe a form for certifying a cigarette rolling machine operator under this part.

subsection.subsection: A cigarette rolling machine operator shall apply to the commission for certification before the cigarette rolling machine operator performs an act described in Subsection (1) within the state for the first time.

A cigarette rolling machine operator shall apply to the commission for a renewal of certification on or before the earlier of: December 31 of each year; or the day on which there is a change in any of the information the cigarette rolling machine operator provides on the form described in Subsection (3).

section.subsection: If the commission determines that a cigarette rolling machine operator meets the requirements for certification or renewal of certification under this section, the commission shall grant the certification or renewal of certification.

If the commission determines that a cigarette rolling machine operator does not meet the requirements for certification or renewal of certification under this section, the commission shall:
deny the certification or renewal of certification; and provide the cigarette rolling machine operator the grounds for denial of the certification or renewal of certification in writing.
